key: Excuse me!
en: Excuse me!
ja: すみません!

key: I'm very sorry! I dropped my necklace around here and I'm trying to find it!
en: I'm very sorry! I dropped my necklace around here and I'm trying to find it!
ja: ごめんなさい! この あたりで ネックレスを 落として しまって 探しているんです!

key: I don't want it to get buried underfoot, so I can't let anyone through right now.
en: I don't want it to get buried underfoot, so I can't let anyone through right now.
ja: 踏まれて 埋もれたら 困るので 今は 誰も 通せないんです。

key: Really sorry!
en: Really sorry!
ja: 本当に すみません!

key: I'll get out of your way as soon as I can!
en: I'll get out of your way as soon as I can!
ja: できるだけ 早く どきますから!

key: I don't want it to get burried underfoot, so I don't want anyone to pass through right now.
en: I don't want it to get burried underfoot, so I don't want anyone to pass through right now.
ja: 踏まれて 埋もれたら 困るので 今は 誰にも 通って ほしくないんです。

key: Really sorry! I'll get out of your way as soon as I can!
en: Really sorry! I'll get out of your way as soon as I can!
ja: 本当に すみません! できるだけ 早く どきますから!

key: I never get bored of ice skating!
en: I never get bored of ice skating!
ja: アイススケートは いくら やっても 飽きないよ!

key: My mom says if I get good enough, she'll let me skate inside the mountain too!
en: My mom says if I get good enough, she'll let me skate inside the mountain too!
ja: もっと 上手に なったら 山の 中でも すべって いいって ママが 言ってた!

key: I love this mountain! Even if we're trapped on it, it's so cool!
en: I love this mountain! Even if we're trapped on it, it's so cool!
ja: この 山 大好き! とじこめられてても すごく かっこいいもん!

key: In the past, the peak was used to hold Gym Battles!
en: In the past, the peak was used to hold Gym Battles!
ja: むかしは 山頂で ジム戦を やってたんだって!

key: The old Gym Leader retired-- I dunno why, I guess he got busy with other things?
en: The old Gym Leader retired-- I dunno why, I guess he got busy with other things?
ja: 前の ジムリーダーは 引退した—— 理由は わかんない ほかの ことで いそがしく なったのかな?

key: But he still lives here!
en: But he still lives here!
ja: でも まだ ここに 住んでるよ!

key: His name is Blake Whitaker! If you see him around, would you get his autograph for me?
en: His name is Blake Whitaker! If you see him around, would you get his autograph for me?
ja: 名前は ブレイク・ホイッタカー! 見かけたら サインを もらってきて くれない?

key: I'd ask him for it myself, but I'm kinda scared of him...
en: I'd ask him for it myself, but I'm kinda scared of him...
ja: 自分で たのみたいけど ちょっと こわいんだ……

key: A-ah... I have to hold onto the edge or I'll fall!
en: A-ah... I have to hold onto the edge or I'll fall!
ja: あわわ……はしに つかまってないと 落ちちゃう!

key: Eep!
en: Eep!
ja: ひゃっ!

key: I'm so glad we can get back to playing! Everyone's happy again here!
en: I'm so glad we can get back to playing! Everyone's happy again here!
ja: また 遊べるように なって うれしい! みんな 元気を 取りもどしたよ!

key: It was really sad when all the food disappeared, because no one had any energy...
en: It was really sad when all the food disappeared, because no one had any energy...
ja: 食べ物が 全部 消えた ときは みんな 元気が なくて 悲しかった……

key: But recently, someone has been sneaking around and secretly distributing food to all the kids!
en: But recently, someone has been sneaking around and secretly distributing food to all the kids!
ja: でも 最近 だれかが こっそり 子どもたち みんなに 食べ物を 配ってくれてるんだ!

key: It's really cool!
en: It's really cool!
ja: すごく かっこいいよね!

key: What's the matter?!
en: What's the matter?!
ja: どうしたの?!

key: Come and catch me! Nyaaaa!
en: Come and catch me! Nyaaaa!
ja: つかまえてごらん! べーっだ!

key: Hrm. It's good to see everyone in high spirits again.
en: Hrm. It's good to see everyone in high spirits again.
ja: ふむ。みんなが また 元気に なって 何よりだ。

key: I can't remember how long it was that the streets of this city were empty, or full of vacant faces looking more like zombies than humans.
en: I can't remember how long it was that the streets of this city were empty, or full of vacant faces looking more like zombies than humans.
ja: この 町の 通りが 人けを 失い 人よりも ゾンビのような うつろな 顔で あふれていた 日々が どれだけ 続いたか 思い出せん。

key: Hunger can do that to a man.
en: Hunger can do that to a man.
ja: 飢えは 人を そこまで 変えて しまう。

key: But when people in the streets started getting fed by a mysterious person, we started to gain hope back. And here we are!
en: But when people in the streets started getting fed by a mysterious person, we started to gain hope back.  And here we are!
ja: だが なぞの 人物が 町の 人々に 食べ物を 配りはじめてから 希望が もどってきた。そして 今が ある!

key: Ahm. But that's all I will say about that person! They must remain mysterious!
en: Ahm. But that's all I will say about that person! They must remain mysterious!
ja: おっと。その 人物の 話は ここまでだ! なぞの ままで なければ ならん!

key: The previous crisis has really taught everyone not to take daily life for granted.
en: The previous crisis has really taught everyone not to take daily life for granted.
ja: この前の 危機で みんな 毎日の 暮らしを 当たり前だと 思っては いけないと 学んだのさ。

key: That's why everyone is out having so much fun.
en: That's why everyone is out having so much fun.
ja: だから みんな 外で あんなに 楽しんでいる。

key: I kinda wish I could join them, but, I'm too old now.
en: I kinda wish I could join them, but, I'm too old now.
ja: わしも 混ざりたいが もう 年を 取りすぎた。

key: I'd look silly out there, right?
en: I'd look silly out there, right?
ja: あそこに 出たら こっけいだろう?

key: Oh? About the previous crisis?
en: Oh? About the previous crisis?
ja: ん? この前の 危機の ことかい?

key: I mean, it's not over yet.
en: I mean, it's not over yet.
ja: いや まだ 終わっては いないんだ。

key: We're still low on food, but...
en: We're still low on food, but...
ja: 食べ物は まだ 足りない だが……

key: Everyone has hope, because as it turns out, this city has a Guardian Angel!
en: Everyone has hope, because as it turns out, this city has a Guardian Angel!
ja: みんな 希望を もっている。この 町には 守護天使が いるんだ!

key: Who's that? Well...
en: Who's that? Well...
ja: だれかって? それは……

key: I can't tell you!
en: I can't tell you!
ja: 言えないな!

key: Just being able to stand here right now is a wonderful thing, and it's all thanks to that girl.
en: Just being able to stand here right now is a wonderful thing, and it's all thanks to that girl.
ja: 今 こうして ここに 立てるだけで すばらしい こと。ぜんぶ あの 娘の おかげさ。

key: Oh my! I shouldn't have said that!
en: Oh my! I shouldn't have said that!
ja: おっと! 今のは 言っては いけなかった!

key: Please do not tell anyone I did!
en: Please do not tell anyone I did!
ja: だれにも 言わないで おくれ!

key: Word has it that if the Guardian Angel's identity gets out, she won't be able to help us anymore!
en: Word has it that if the Guardian Angel's identity gets out, she won't be able to help us anymore!
ja: 守護天使の 正体が 知れたら もう 助けて もらえなく なるという 話なんだ!

key: I promised my son I wouldn't tell anyone, so please keep this quiet.
en: I promised my son I wouldn't tell anyone, so please keep this quiet.
ja: 息子と だれにも 言わないと 約束したんだ。どうか 内緒に して おくれ。

key: The air up here may be cold, but it's pure.
en: The air up here may be cold, but it's pure.
ja: ここの 空気は 冷たいが 澄んでいる。

key: I'd take this life over Reborn City's any day.
en: I'd take this life over Reborn City's any day.
ja: リボーンシティの 暮らしより こっちの ほうが ずっと いい。

key: Hunger and all.
en: Hunger and all.
ja: 飢えも ひっくるめて な。

key: Howdy, stranger.
en: Howdy, stranger.
ja: やあ　見ない顔だね

key: You don't look like you're dressed for this climate. Conserve heat and stay indoors.
en: You don't look like you're dressed for this climate.  Conserve heat and stay indoors.
ja: その 服装では この 気候に 合わんぞ。体温を 保って 屋内に いなさい。

key: And remember, try not to move around too much if you haven't got your rations.
en: And remember, try not to move around too much if you haven't got your rations.
ja: それと 配給を もらっていないなら あまり 動きまわらない ことだ。

key: You see, most of our foodstock disappeared recently.
en: You see, most of our foodstock disappeared recently.
ja: じつは 最近 食料の ほとんどが 消えて しまってな。

key: We know that Ametrine Mountain had been blocked off, but that's okay, because we always used to store plenty to live on in emergencies.
en: We know that Ametrine Mountain had been blocked off, but that's okay, because we always used to store plenty to live on in emergencies.
ja: アメトリン山が ふさがれたのは 知っている。だが 非常時に 備えて いつも 十分に たくわえていたから 問題は なかった。

key: But just when that happened, our emergency supply completely disappeared.
en: But just when that happened, our emergency supply completely disappeared.
ja: ところが ちょうど その とき 非常用の たくわえが 丸ごと 消えたんだ。

key: We're not really sure how.
en: We're not really sure how.
ja: どうしてかは わからん。

key: Ever since then, the city has been living on the rations of the public food store.
en: Ever since then, the city has been living on the rations of the public food store.
ja: それ以来 町は 公共の 食料庫の 配給で 暮らしている。

key: It's been very difficult, but we WILL get through this!
en: It's been very difficult, but we WILL get through this!
ja: とても 苦しいが 必ず 乗りこえて みせる!

key: A visitor?
en: A visitor?
ja: よそから 来た のかい?

key: Does that mean the mountain path has been unblocked?
en: Does that mean the mountain path has been unblocked?
ja: 山道の ふうさが 解けたって ことか?

key: I never used to like eating bread by itself, but when you're really starving, it's amazing how delicious it can be!
en: I never used to like eating bread by itself, but when you're really starving, it's amazing how delicious it can be!
ja: パンだけで 食べるのは 好きじゃ なかったけど 本当に 飢えていると おどろくほど おいしいんだ!

key: Pretty sure there's some zen philosophy like that or something, isn't there?
en: Pretty sure there's some zen philosophy like that or something, isn't there?
ja: そういう 禅の 教えが あった 気が するな?

key: Maybe I should visit Apophyll.
en: Maybe I should visit Apophyll.
ja: アポフィルに 行ってみようかな。

key: Much better!
en: Much better!
ja: ずっと いいね!

key: There's nothing to go along with a pleasant snowstorm like an entire crate of newly-reclaimed food!
en: There's nothing to go along with a pleasant snowstorm like an entire crate of newly-reclaimed food!
ja: 心地よい 吹雪に 取りもどしたばかりの 食料 ひと箱ほど 合う ものは ないね!

key: Hey hey, do you know about this house?
en: Hey hey, do you know about this house?
ja: ねえねえ この 家の こと 知ってる?

key: They say it's haunted!
en: They say it's haunted!
ja: おばけが 出るんだって!

key: A big accident happened there years ago and the girls who were living there died!
en: A big accident happened there years ago and the girls who were living there died!
ja: 何年も 前に 大きな 事故が あって 住んでた 女の子たちが 死んじゃったんだ!

key: It's super creepy! But super cool!
en: It's super creepy! But super cool!
ja: すっごく 不気味! でも すっごく かっこいい!

key: SHELLY: Hey! Um, I have a different question about what you t-told me before. Is that okay?
en: SHELLY: Hey! Um, I have a different question about what you t-told me before. Is that okay?
ja: シェリー: あの! さっき は、話して くれた ことで 別の しつもんが あるの……いい かな?

key: You said before you can't tell me about the Guardian Angel who was giving you all food... but could you maybe tell us what would happen if you did?
en: You said before you can't tell me about the Guardian Angel who was giving you all food... but could you maybe tell us what would happen if you did?
ja: 食べ物を 配って くれた 守護天使の ことは 言えないって 話だったけど……もし 言ったら どう なるのかは 教えて もらえる?

key: KID: Huh? If I told you who the Guardian Angel is?
en: KID: Huh? If I told you who the Guardian Angel is?
ja: こども: え? 守護天使が だれか 教えたら って こと?

key: SHELLY: Y-yeah. Can you tell us what would happen?
en: SHELLY: Y-yeah. Can you tell us what would happen?
ja: シェリー: う、うん。どう なるか 教えて くれる?

key: KID: Um, well, if I told you who it was and word got out, then we probably wouldn't get any more food.
en: KID: Um, well, if I told you who it was and word got out, then we probably wouldn't get any more food.
ja: こども: えっと……だれか 教えて それが 広まったら たぶん もう 食べ物は もらえなく なる。

key: SHELLY: Huh? This Guardian Angel person would do that to punish you?
en: SHELLY: Huh? This Guardian Angel person would do that to punish you?
ja: シェリー: え? 守護天使が ばつとして そう するの?

key: KID: No! She would never!
en: KID: No! She would never!
ja: こども: ちがう! 彼女は そんな こと しない!

key: I mean, um, they would never!
en: I mean, um, they would never!
ja: じゃなくて えっと その 人は そんな こと しない!

key: SHELLY: I don't get it then. Why?
en: SHELLY: I don't get it then. Why?
ja: シェリー: じゃあ わからないよ。どうして?

key: KID: Um, I think it's not the Guardian Angel we have to worry about.
en: KID: Um, I think it's not the Guardian Angel we have to worry about.
ja: こども: えっと……心配なのは 守護天使じゃ ないんだ。

key: It's the person looking after her.
en: It's the person looking after her.
ja: その 人の 面倒を みている 人の ほう。

key: She doesn't want him finding out that she's doing it...
en: She doesn't want him finding out that she's doing it...
ja: 彼女は 自分が やってるって その 人に 知られたく ないんだ……

key: SHELLY: Oh... Okay.
en: SHELLY: Oh... Okay.
ja: シェリー: あ……そう なんだ。

key: Um... Can I ask who that person is?
en: Um... Can I ask who that person is?
ja: えっと……その 人が だれか 聞いても いい?

key: You aren't sworn to keep a secret about that, right?
en: You aren't sworn to keep a secret about that, right?
ja: それは 秘密に するって 約束して ないよね?

key: KID: I... Um, I guess not.
en: KID: I... Um, I guess not.
ja: こども: それは……うん たぶん 大丈夫。

key: You promise you won't let him find out?
en: You promise you won't let him find out?
ja: その 人に ばれないって 約束して くれる?

key: SHELLY: Yeah! We promise!
en: SHELLY: Yeah! We promise!
ja: シェリー: うん! 約束する!

key: Right, \PN?
en: Right, \PN?
ja: ね、\PN?

key: KID: The man's name is Blake.
en: KID: The man's name is Blake.
ja: こども: その 人の 名前は ブレイク。

key: He's kind of a jerk. He wears a light blue jacket and has a mohawky-thing.
en: He's kind of a jerk. He wears a light blue jacket and has a mohawky-thing.
ja: ちょっと いやな 奴。水色の 上着を 着てて 頭が モヒカンみたいなんだ。

key: SHELLY: \PN! \PN, \PN, \PN! That was him!
en: SHELLY: \PN! \PN, \PN, \PN! That was him!
ja: シェリー: \PN! \PN、\PN、\PN! さっきの 人だ!

key: Huh? Cain told you Blake adopted Heather?
en: Huh? Cain told you Blake adopted Heather?
ja: え? ブレイクが ヘザーを 引き取ったって カインが 言ってたの?

key: Then this Guardian Angel HAS to be Heather!
en: Then this Guardian Angel HAS to be Heather!
ja: じゃあ この 守護天使は ぜったい ヘザーだよ!

key: She's been the one giving food to everyone in Ametrine!
en: She's been the one giving food to everyone in Ametrine!
ja: アメトリンの みんなに 食べ物を 配ってたのは ヘザーなんだ!

key: KID: Hey, quiet down!
en: KID: Hey, quiet down!
ja: こども: ちょっと 静かに して!

key: SHELLY: Oops... Sorry!
en: SHELLY: Oops... Sorry!
ja: シェリー: あっ……ごめんなさい!

key: Um, hey, do you know where we could find her?
en: Um, hey, do you know where we could find her?
ja: あの……ヘザーが どこに いるか 知らない?

key: KID: Nu-uh.
en: KID: Nu-uh.
ja: こども: ううん。

key: Actually, I think it's been a few days since anyone's seen her.
en: Actually, I think it's been a few days since anyone's seen her.
ja: そういえば ここ 何日か だれも 見てない と 思う。

key: Maybe she went to go find us more food? I dunno.
en: Maybe she went to go find us more food? I dunno.
ja: もっと 食べ物を 探しに 行ったのかな? わかんない。

key: SHELLY: That's not good.
en: SHELLY: That's not good.
ja: シェリー: それは よくないよ。

key: Well, m-maybe we should just ask Blake?
en: Well, m-maybe we should just ask Blake?
ja: その……ぶ、ブレイクに 聞いてみる?

key: KID: What?! You can't do that!
en: KID: What?! You can't do that!
ja: こども: ええっ?! だめだよ そんなの!

key: He'll find out!
en: He'll find out!
ja: ばれちゃう!

key: SHELLY: Don't worry! We won't say anything about her being the Guardian Angel!
en: SHELLY: Don't worry! We won't say anything about her being the Guardian Angel!
ja: シェリー: 大丈夫! 守護天使の ことは 何も 言わないから!

key: She's my friend! I'm just trying to find her!
en: She's my friend! I'm just trying to find her!
ja: あの子は わたしの 友だち! ただ 探したいだけなの!

key: Can you tell us where Blake lives?
en: Can you tell us where Blake lives?
ja: ブレイクが どこに 住んでるか 教えて くれる?

key: KID: Um... It's right at the top of the hill.
en: KID: Um... It's right at the top of the hill.
ja: こども: えっと……坂を 上りきった ところだよ。

key: I'll go leave it open for you if you want... But then I'm not gonna be involved with this anymore!
en: I'll go leave it open for you if you want... But then I'm not gonna be involved with this anymore!
ja: よかったら 開けておいて あげる……でも これ以上 かかわらないからね!

key: SHELLY: Thank you so much! I'm right behind you!
en: SHELLY: Thank you so much! I'm right behind you!
ja: シェリー: 本当に ありがとう! すぐ 後を 追うね!

key: SHELLY: Brrr!
en: SHELLY: Brrr!
ja: シェリー: さ、寒い!

key: I don't know how anyone can stand this cold!
en: I don't know how anyone can stand this cold!
ja: この 寒さに よく たえられるね!

key: But if Heather is here somewhere, I'll definitely find her!
en: But if Heather is here somewhere, I'll definitely find her!
ja: でも ヘザーが どこかに いるなら 絶対 見つけるから!

key: Let's split up and ask around!
en: Let's split up and ask around!
ja: 手分けして 聞いて まわろう!

key: I bet someone is bound to know something!
en: I bet someone is bound to know something!
ja: きっと だれかが 何か 知ってるはず!

key: After we talk to everyone, let's meet up somewhere.
en: After we talk to everyone, let's meet up somewhere.
ja: みんなに 聞き終わったら どこかで 落ち合おう。

key: Hm, maybe there's a suspicious place around here?
en: Hm, maybe there's a suspicious place around here?
ja: うーん この あたりに あやしい 場所が あるかな?

key: I'm going to look for something like that once I'm done!
en: I'm going to look for something like that once I'm done!
ja: わたしは 終わったら そういう 場所を 探してみる!

key: Good luck!
en: Good luck!
ja: がんばってね!

key: KID: Um, well, if I told you who it was and word got out, then we probably wouldn't get anymore food.
en: KID: Um, well, if I told you who it was and word got out, then we probably wouldn't get anymore food.
ja: こども: えっと……だれか 教えて それが 広まったら たぶん もう 食べ物は もらえなく なる。

key: SHELLY: \PN! \PN, \PN, \PN!
en: SHELLY: \PN! \PN, \PN, \PN!
ja: シェリー: \PN! \PN、\PN、\PN!

key: That WAS him!
en: That WAS him!
ja: やっぱり さっきの 人だ!

key: I thought so, but I wasn't sure!
en: I thought so, but I wasn't sure!
ja: そうだと 思ってたけど 確信が なかったの!

key: Maybe she went to go find us more food?
en: Maybe she went to go find us more food?
ja: もっと 食べ物を 探しに 行ったのかな?

key: I dunno.
en: I dunno.
ja: わかんない。

key: SHELLY: Don't worry!
en: SHELLY: Don't worry!
ja: シェリー: 大丈夫!

key: We won't say anything about her being the Guardian Angel!
en: We won't say anything about her being the Guardian Angel!
ja: 守護天使の ことは 何も 言わないから!

key: She's my friend!
en: She's my friend!
ja: あの子は わたしの 友だち!

key: I'm just trying to find her!
en: I'm just trying to find her!
ja: ただ 探したいだけなの!

key: I'll go leave it open for you if you want...
en: I'll go leave it open for you if you want...
ja: よかったら 開けておいて あげる……

key: But then I'm not gonna be involved with this anymore!
en: But then I'm not gonna be involved with this anymore!
ja: でも これ以上 かかわらないからね!

key: SHELLY: Thank you so much!
en: SHELLY: Thank you so much!
ja: シェリー: 本当に ありがとう!

key: I'm right behind you!
en: I'm right behind you!
ja: すぐ 後を 追うね!

ja: キャル: 俺の 髪は もともと この 色だ。

key: Or something close.
en: Or something close.
ja: 近い 色 と いうべきか。

key: I had it dyed back.
en: I had it dyed back.
ja: 元の 色に 染め 戻した。

key: SHELLY: H-huh? Why?
en: SHELLY: H-huh? Why?
ja: シェリー: え、ええ? どうして?

key: CAL: It seemed like the thing to do.
en: CAL: It seemed like the thing to do.
ja: キャル: そう するべきだと 思った。

key: That's all.
en: That's all.
ja: それだけだ。

key: I spent most of my life trying to do everything in response to my brother.
en: I spent most of my life trying to do everything in response to my brother.
ja: 俺は 人生の ほとんどを 兄への 反発で 動いて きた。

key: Dyed my hair to be different from his, tried to join both the Reborn League and Team Meteor to one-up him...
en: Dyed my hair to be different from his, tried to join both the Reborn League and Team Meteor to one-up him...
ja: 兄と 違う 色に 髪を 染め 兄を 出しぬく ために リボーンリーグにも メテオだんにも 入ろうと した……

key: SHELLY: Wait, you what?!
en: SHELLY: Wait, you what?!
ja: シェリー: え、ちょっと 今 なんて?!

key: CAL: Ugh, you didn't know about that.
en: CAL: Ugh, you didn't know about that.
ja: キャル: しまった それは 知らなかったか。

key: Don't be alarmed.
en: Don't be alarmed.
ja: おどろかなくて いい。

key: I've left that behind.
en: I've left that behind.
ja: もう 捨てた ことだ。

key: I was a walking mistake.
en: I was a walking mistake.
ja: 俺は 歩く 間違いだった。

key: I was trying to be someone better than my brother, when I should've just been trying to be myself.
en: I was trying to be someone better than my brother, when I should've just been trying to be myself.
ja: 兄より 上の 人間に なろうと していた。ただ 自分に なれば よかったのに。

key: So I'm fixing that.
en: So I'm fixing that.
ja: だから それを 直している。

key: Going back to myself.
en: Going back to myself.
ja: 自分に 戻るんだ。

key: Having my natural hair color is weird, but it's fine.
en: Having my natural hair color is weird, but it's fine.
ja: 地毛の 色は 落ち着かないが かまわない。

key: After all, blue flame burns even hotter.
en: After all, blue flame burns even hotter.
ja: なにしろ 青い 炎の ほうが 熱いからな。

key: That also means that I need to stop Team Meteor as much as anyone else.
en: That also means that I need to stop Team Meteor as much as anyone else.
ja: つまり 俺も 人一倍 メテオだんを 止める 必要が ある。

key: So don't be afraid, all right?
en: So don't be afraid, all right?
ja: だから こわがらなくて いい いいな?

key: SHELLY: Al-all right...
en: SHELLY: Al-all right...
ja: シェリー: う、うん……

key: If you say so...
en: If you say so...
ja: そう 言うなら……

key: CAL: Thanks.
en: CAL: Thanks.
ja: キャル: ありがとう。

key: I'm glad we had the chance to meet again like this.
en: I'm glad we had the chance to meet again like this.
ja: こうして また 会えて よかった。

key: SHELLY: Come to think of it, if we'd have been just a few minutes off, this might not have happened?
en: SHELLY: Come to think of it, if we'd have been just a few minutes off, this might not have happened?
ja: シェリー: 考えてみたら 数分 ずれてたら こう なって なかったかも?

key: CAL: I'm guessing you were just speaking to my brother.
en: CAL: I'm guessing you were just speaking to my brother.
ja: キャル: 今しがた 兄と 話していたんだろう。

key: SHELLY: Yeah! He locked up Heather and we need to find her!
en: SHELLY: Yeah! He locked up Heather and we need to find her!
ja: シェリー: うん! ヘザーを 閉じこめたの 早く 見つけないと!

key: CAL: That's not all.
en: CAL: That's not all.
ja: キャル: それだけじゃ ない。

key: I overheard him radioing Team Meteor for back-up.
en: I overheard him radioing Team Meteor for back-up.
ja: あいつが 無線で メテオだんに 応援を 呼ぶのを 聞いた。

key: They're dispatching an air unit here, right now.
en: They're dispatching an air unit here, right now.
ja: 今 こっちへ 航空部隊を 送り出している。

key: SHELLY: Huh? Oh no!
en: SHELLY: Huh? Oh no!
ja: シェリー: え? そんな!

key: He's trying to give them the Ring!
en: He's trying to give them the Ring!
ja: ゆびわを 渡す つもりなんだ!

key: CAL: Right. I don't think I need to explain why that's not a good thing.
en: CAL: Right. I don't think I need to explain why that's not a good thing.
ja: キャル: そうだ。それが まずい 理由は 説明するまでも ないな。

key: SHELLY: What do we do?
en: SHELLY: What do we do?
ja: シェリー: どう すれば いいの?

key: We still have to find Heather, and stop him at the same time!
en: We still have to find Heather, and stop him at the same time!
ja: ヘザーも 見つけて 同時に あの人も 止めなきゃ!

key: CAL: Right, your friend with the Salamence...
en: CAL: Right, your friend with the Salamence...
ja: キャル: そうだ ボーマンダを 連れた 友だち だったな……

key: Didn't you also say that she was in the Elite Four or something?
en: Didn't you also say that she was in the Elite Four or something?
ja: 四天王か 何かだと 言っていなかったか?

key: SHELLY: Yeah, you remember!
en: SHELLY: Yeah, you remember!
ja: シェリー: うん 覚えててくれたんだ!

key: CAL: How does a girl that young get into something like that?
en: CAL: How does a girl that young get into something like that?
ja: キャル: あんな 年の 子が どうして そんな 立場に?

key: SHELLY: Huh? Um, well... I think I remember that her mom used to be part of it a long time ago...
en: SHELLY: Huh? Um, well... I think I remember that her mom used to be part of it a long time ago...
ja: シェリー: え? えっと……たしか ずっと 前に お母さんが その 一員だったはず……

key: So I guess she proved she was good enough to take over?
en: So I guess she proved she was good enough to take over?
ja: だから 継げるだけの 実力を 示したんじゃ ないかな?

key: CAL: We could use her strength.
en: CAL: We could use her strength.
ja: キャル: その 力は 使える。

key: She can fly out and deal with the air unit, leaving us free to chase down Blake.
en: She can fly out and deal with the air unit, leaving us free to chase down Blake.
ja: 彼女が 飛んで 航空部隊を 抑えれば こちらは ブレイクを 追える。

key: We get him, take the Ring, and then when the air unit comes in late thanks to Heather, I'll take out Solaris myself.
en: We get him, take the Ring, and then when the air unit comes in late thanks to Heather, I'll take out Solaris myself.
ja: あいつを 押さえて ゆびわを 奪う。ヘザーの おかげで 遅れて 来る 航空部隊は 俺が ソラリスごと 片づける。

key: I owe him a thing or two.
en: I owe him a thing or two.
ja: あいつには 借りが ある。

key: SHELLY: But we need Heather for that!
en: SHELLY: But we need Heather for that!
ja: シェリー: でも それには ヘザーが 必要だよ!

key: CAL: Yeah, I have a feeling I know where she is.
en: CAL: Yeah, I have a feeling I know where she is.
ja: キャル: ああ 居場所は 見当が ついている。

key: SHELLY: You do?!
en: SHELLY: You do?!
ja: シェリー: 本当に?!

key: CAL: I grew up in this place too, so I know all about it.
en: CAL: I grew up in this place too, so I know all about it.
ja: キャル: 俺も ここで 育った。この 町の ことは 知り尽くしている。

key: Check out Blake's apartment.
en: Check out Blake's apartment.
ja: ブレイクの 部屋を 調べろ。

key: Look very carefully and there should be a hidden passage of some kind.
en: Look very carefully and there should be a hidden passage of some kind.
ja: よく 見れば 隠し通路が あるはずだ。

key: SHELLY: R-really? That's crazy!
en: SHELLY: R-really? That's crazy!
ja: シェリー: ほ、本当? すごい!

key: CAL: We used it a lot when meeting with Team Meteor.
en: CAL: We used it a lot when meeting with Team Meteor.
ja: キャル: メテオだんと 会う ときに よく 使っていた。

key: But, I'll bet he's changed the security on it since then.
en: But, I'll bet he's changed the security on it since then.
ja: だが あれから 仕掛けを 変えている だろうな。

key: So I'll leave that to you two.
en: So I'll leave that to you two.
ja: そこは 君たち 2人に 任せる。

key: In the meantime, I'm going after Blake.
en: In the meantime, I'm going after Blake.
ja: その間に 俺は ブレイクを 追う。

key: I'll need to slow him down.
en: I'll need to slow him down.
ja: 足止めして おく 必要が ある。

key: Are you both clear?
en: Are you both clear?
ja: 2人とも いいな?

key: Investigate Blake's room and find the hidden passage.
en: Investigate Blake's room and find the hidden passage.
ja: ブレイクの 部屋を 調べて 隠し通路を 見つけろ。

key: Let's go. Time is short!
en: Let's go. Time is short!
ja: 行くぞ。時間が ない!

key: SHELLY: All right, Heather, use Ancient Power.
en: SHELLY: All right, Heather, use Ancient Power.
ja: シェリー: よし ヘザー げんしのちからを!

key: Tear that door off!
en: Tear that door off!
ja: その 扉を こじ開けて!

key: SHELLY: We did it!
en: SHELLY: We did it!
ja: シェリー: やったね!

key: HEATHER: Salamence, return.
en: HEATHER: Salamence, return.
ja: ヘザー: ボーマンダ もどって。

key: SHELLY: Heather, return!
en: SHELLY: Heather, return!
ja: シェリー: ヘザー もどって!

key: HEATHER: Thanks for coming for me.
en: HEATHER: Thanks for coming for me.
ja: ヘザー: 助けに 来てくれて ありがと。

key: SHELLY: Of course! That's what friends do, right?
en: SHELLY: Of course! That's what friends do, right?
ja: シェリー: 当然だよ! 友だちなんだから ね?

key: HEATHER: Yeah.
en: HEATHER: Yeah.
ja: ヘザー: うん。

key: I never was much of a friend though.
en: I never was much of a friend though.
ja: アタシは たいして いい 友だちじゃ なかったけど。

key: SHELLY: You were to me.
en: SHELLY: You were to me.
ja: シェリー: わたしには そうだったよ。

key: You were all I had.
en: You were all I had.
ja: あなただけが いてくれたの。

key: HEATHER: Shelly, I'm sorry--
en: HEATHER: Shelly, I'm sorry--
ja: ヘザー: シェリー、ごめん——

key: SHELLY: It's okay!
en: SHELLY: It's okay!
ja: シェリー: いいの!

key: Don't worry.
en: Don't worry.
ja: 気にしないで。

key: Someone just told me that everyone makes mistakes.
en: Someone just told me that everyone makes mistakes.
ja: だれでも 間違えるって さっき 教わったの。

key: Nothing can change the past, but we can always fix the future.
en: Nothing can change the past, but we can always fix the future.
ja: 過去は 変えられないけど 未来は いつでも 直せるって。

key: So, I forgive you.
en: So, I forgive you.
ja: だから わたしは 許す。

key: I'd forgive him, too.
en: I'd forgive him, too.
ja: あの人の ことも 許すよ。

key: HEATHER: Right... Thanks.
en: HEATHER: Right... Thanks.
ja: ヘザー: そう……ありがと。

key: You too, \PN.
en: You too, \PN.
ja: \PNも ね。

key: I haven't been very nice, but you've done a lot for me.
en: I haven't been very nice, but you've done a lot for me.
ja: 感じよく なかったのに いろいろ してくれた。

key: SHELLY: Hey, listen, we need your help.
en: SHELLY: Hey, listen, we need your help.
ja: シェリー: ねえ 聞いて 力を 貸して ほしいの。

key: Blake stole your ring.
en: Blake stole your ring.
ja: ブレイクが あなたの ゆびわを 盗んだの。

key: HEATHER: Mom's ring?
en: HEATHER: Mom's ring?
ja: ヘザー: ママの ゆびわ?

key: He has it?
en: He has it?
ja: あいつが 持ってるの?

key: SHELLY: Yeah! And he's trying to turn it over to Team Meteor.
en: SHELLY: Yeah! And he's trying to turn it over to Team Meteor.
ja: シェリー: うん! それを メテオだんに 渡そうと してる。

key: They're sending an air unit up here now to retrieve it, so we need to stop him!
en: They're sending an air unit up here now to retrieve it, so we need to stop him!
ja: 受け取る ために 今 航空部隊が 来てるの。止めなきゃ!

key: HEATHER: Duh, we do!
en: HEATHER: Duh, we do!
ja: ヘザー: 当たり前でしょ!

key: What are we waiting for?
en: What are we waiting for?
ja: 何を 待ってんの?

key: I'm gonna knock his head off after everything he did!
en: I'm gonna knock his head off after everything he did!
ja: あれだけ やっといて タダで すむと 思うな!

key: SHELLY: For locking you up?
en: SHELLY: For locking you up?
ja: シェリー: 閉じこめられた こと?

key: HEATHER: Ugh, who cares about that?!
en: HEATHER: Ugh, who cares about that?!
ja: ヘザー: そんなの どうでも いい!

key: For trying to starve an entire city!
en: For trying to starve an entire city!
ja: 町ぜんぶを 飢えさせようと したから!

key: I tried to feed them secretly, cuz that's what anyone would do, right?
en: I tried to feed them secretly, cuz that's what anyone would do, right?
ja: こっそり 食べ物を 配ったのは だれだって そう するからでしょ?

key: If they found where he was hiding the food.
en: If they found where he was hiding the food.
ja: 食べ物の 隠し場所を 見つけたらね。

key: But then he caught me and here we are.
en: But then he caught me and here we are.
ja: でも 見つかって この ざま。

key: So I owe him big time!
en: So I owe him big time!
ja: だから きっちり 返してやる!

key: SHELLY: Speaking of time, Cal thinks we don't have much of it.
en: SHELLY: Speaking of time, Cal thinks we don't have much of it.
ja: シェリー: 時間といえば、キャルは　もう あまり残っていないって　思ってるみたい。

key: \PN, could you go help him out?
en: \PN, could you go help him out?
ja: \PN、キャルを　助けに　行ってくれる?

key: We'll be right behind you!
en: We'll be right behind you!
ja: わたしたちも　すぐ　追いつくから!

key: I just wanna talk to Heather for a little bit. Sorry...
en: I just wanna talk to Heather for a little bit. Sorry...
ja: ちょっとだけ　ヘザーと　話したくて。ごめんね……

key: HEATHER: Yeah, for sure.
en: HEATHER: Yeah, for sure.
ja: ヘザー: うん、もちろん。

key: Let's go smack a few of them out of the sky!
en: Let's go smack a few of them out of the sky!
ja: 空にいる　連中を　たたき落として　やろっ!

key: Salamence can carry you!
en: Salamence can carry you!
ja: ボーマンダが　乗せてってくれる!

key: SHELLY: So we'll meet you up on the peak, okay \PN?
en: SHELLY: So we'll meet you up on the peak, okay \PN?
ja: シェリー: だから　山頂で　合流しよう、いいかな \PN?

key: BLAKE: Enough, enough already!
en: BLAKE: Enough, enough already!
ja: ブレイク: もういい、もう　じゅうぶんだ!

key: Geez bro, I thought you used to be whiny,
en: Geez bro, I thought you used to be whiny,
ja: まったく　ブラザー、昔から　めそめそ野郎だとは　思ってたけどな

key: But please, miss me with that hippie Apophyll zen shit!
en: But please, miss me with that hippie Apophyll zen shit!
ja: だが　頼むから　その　アポフィル流の　ありがたい　お説教は　やめてくれ!

key: CAL: Nothing I'm saying is for your benefit.
en: CAL: Nothing I'm saying is for your benefit.
ja: キャル: 俺の言葉は　お前のために　言ってるんじゃない。

key: You asked me a question, and I answered.
en: You asked me a question, and I answered.
ja: お前が　聞いたから　答えただけだ。

key: BLAKE: Damn, lesson learned.
en: BLAKE: Damn, lesson learned.
ja: ブレイク: はいはい、勉強に　なったよ。

key: Spare me the sermon.
en: Spare me the sermon.
ja: 説教は　勘弁してくれ。

key: Look, tell you what, you can talk to that tree behind you.
en: Look, tell you what, you can talk to that tree behind you.
ja: いいか、そこの　後ろの木にでも　話しかけてろよ。

key: I promise you, it cares almost as much as I do.
en: I promise you, it cares almost as much as I do.
ja: 保証するぜ、そいつも　俺と　同じくらい　興味あるからさ。

key: I, however, am a little bit busy, so peace.
en: I, however, am a little bit busy, so peace.
ja: 俺はな、ちょっと　忙しいんだ。じゃあな。

key: BLAKE: You know, I don't think I'll be doing that.
en: BLAKE: You know, I don't think I'll be doing that.
ja: ブレイク: なあ、俺は　そんなこと　するつもりないぜ。

key: But whatever other concerns or tragic life stories you have, I'm sure those two will be happy to indulge you.
en: But whatever other concerns or tragic life stories you have, I'm sure those two will be happy to indulge you.
ja: だが　他の悩みだの　悲劇の身の上話だのは、そこの二人が　喜んで　聞いてくれるさ。

key: I'm outtie.
en: I'm outtie.
ja: 俺は　落ちるわ。

key: I think I'd have preferred the life story...
en: I think I'd have preferred the life story...
ja: 身の上話のほうが　まだ　ましだったな……

key: Tch, no worries, we just needed to keep them busy anyway.
en: Tch, no worries, we just needed to keep them busy anyway.
ja: チッ、気にするな。どうせ　足止めできれば　よかったんだ。

key: CAL: Get out of here already, chumps.
en: CAL: Get out of here already, chumps.
ja: キャル: さっさと　消えろ、雑魚ども。

key: I've put you behind me.
en: I've put you behind me.
ja: お前たちとは　もう　縁を切った。

key: METEOR: So we've heard.
en: METEOR: So we've heard.
ja: メテオだん: そう　聞いてるぜ。

key: Do you really think you'll get away with it?
en: Do you really think you'll get away with it?
ja: 本当に　ただで済むと　思ってるのか?

key: CAL: Don't act like that matters to you.
en: CAL: Don't act like that matters to you.
ja: キャル: 気にしてるフリは　やめろ。

key: Go on.
en: Go on.
ja: とっとと　行け。

key: METEOR: As you wish. Until next time~
en: METEOR: As you wish. Until next time~
ja: メテオだん: お望みどおりに。またな〜

key: CAL: Thanks for your help, \PN.
en: CAL: Thanks for your help, \PN.
ja: キャル: 助かったよ、\PN。

key: But it looks like we have a chase ahead of us.
en: But it looks like we have a chase ahead of us.
ja: だが　追いかけっこは　これからだ。

key: Blake's heading to the peak to rendezvous.
en: Blake's heading to the peak to rendezvous.
ja: ブレイクは　合流のため　山頂へ　向かってる。

key: There's no way I'm letting him get there!
en: There's no way I'm letting him get there!
ja: たどり着かせるわけには　いかない!

key: BLAKE: Bruh, you really don't know when to quit, do you?
en: BLAKE: Bruh, you really don't know when to quit, do you?
ja: ブレイク: おいおい、あきらめって　言葉を　知らねえのか?

key: SHELLY: We'll quit when you give us back the Ring!
en: SHELLY: We'll quit when you give us back the Ring!
ja: シェリー: ゆびわを　返してくれたら　やめる!

key: BLAKE: What a fascinating declaration!
en: BLAKE: What a fascinating declaration!
ja: ブレイク: そりゃまた　ご立派な　宣言だな!

key: What do you think, Mr. Grunt?
en: What do you think, Mr. Grunt?
ja: どう思う、したっぱさん?

key: METEOR: I think she needs some manners.
en: METEOR: I think she needs some manners.
ja: メテオだん: 礼儀を　教えてやる　必要が　ありそうだな。

key: METEOR: We can teach them to her.
en: METEOR: We can teach them to her.
ja: メテオだん: 俺たちが　教えてやるさ。

key: You go on ahead, agent.
en: You go on ahead, agent.
ja: あんたは　先に行け、エージェント。

key: Solaris has almost arrived.
en: Solaris has almost arrived.
ja: ソラリス様が　まもなく　到着する。

key: BLAKE: GG, easy.
en: BLAKE: GG, easy.
ja: ブレイク: GG、よゆーだな。

key: METEOR: Even if you win, it's gonna be too late.
en: METEOR: Even if you win, it's gonna be too late.
ja: メテオだん: 勝ったところで　もう　手遅れだ。

key: So sorry.
en: So sorry.
ja: お気の毒にな。

key: SHELLY: All right, I'm going!
en: SHELLY: All right, I'm going!
ja: シェリー: よし、わたしが　行く!

key: For Heather, and Cal, and-- everyone!
en: For Heather, and Cal, and-- everyone!
ja: ヘザーのため、キャルのため、それに——みんなのために!

key: BLAKE: Aaand here we go again.
en: BLAKE: Aaand here we go again.
ja: ブレイク: はいはい、また　これかよ。

key: SHELLY: I'm s-sorry, \PN...
en: SHELLY: I'm s-sorry, \PN...
ja: シェリー: ご、ごめん、\PN……

key: I thought I could d-do it, but I already lost.
en: I thought I could d-do it, but I already lost.
ja: で、できると　思ったのに、負けちゃった。

key: BLAKE: Pfft, don't kid yourself.
en: BLAKE: Pfft, don't kid yourself.
ja: ブレイク: ぷっ、笑わせるなよ。
